behavior_scope: Actual model responses using precomputed actual script output; tool invocation was not available in this experiment. Stored responses are development snapshots, not identical to the final SKILL.md hash.
observations: Both old English and new Chinese descriptions routed all eleven selected prompts correctly with this model; no evidence that English always fails or that routing accuracy improved.
New tarot answer referred to actual three card positions and gave one optional action without asserting colleague thoughts.
Unknown-time answer preserved the day range and did not invent an ascendant or houses; it discussed moon sign from sampled signs and stated sampling limits.
Missing QiMen engine was disclosed before offering external-chart and real-world alternatives.
limitations: One model, one run per batch; no statistical claim or general auto-activation success rate.
Behavior outputs have not been tested as complete multi-turn interactions with real host tools.
Human taste and reliability across other providers still require feedback.
